justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/history/HistoryItemAdapter.java, plus the related android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/history/HistoryItem.java and android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/history/HistoryActivity.java. The adapter is very small (71 lines) and contains only one constructor and one overridden method, getView(), which just inflates/binds a history list row and handles the empty-state row; the actual history data logic lives in HistoryItem and the list-management/actions live in HistoryActivity. That limited method surface and single UI-binding responsibility do not indicate insufficient modularization.
